title: Expense Tracker CLI
summary: A modular command-line expense tracker with monthly reports and CSV export.
thumbnailAlt: Terminal output of the expense tracker: a list of five expenses and a monthly summary by category.

title: Tabular Prediction with Exploratory Analysis
summary: Predicts whether a person earns above 50K from census data, with three models compared by cross-validation and an error analysis.
thumbnailAlt: Bar chart comparing a baseline and three models on seven metrics. Gradient boosting scores best on six of them.

title: Library REST API with Database
summary: A REST API for a small library: books, members and loans in PostgreSQL, with validation, paging, token login and an OpenAPI page.
thumbnailAlt: The OpenAPI page of the Library API, listing the login and book endpoints with an Authorize button.

title: React Full-Stack Mini App
summary: A librarian's web app for the SD-02 Library API: sign in, then manage books, members and loans.
thumbnailAlt: The app's book list: titles, authors, years and ISBNs, each book marked Available or On loan, with Lend, Edit and Delete buttons.
